map.由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩: Find the gravity torque from link mass, length and angle
map.输入质量 m、臂长 L、角度 θ、g，求关节重力扭矩。: Enter the mass m, arm length L, angle θ and g to get the joint gravity torque.
map.📖 查看「由连杆质量、长度与角度求重力扭矩 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the gravity torque from link mass, length and angle"
map.τ = m·g·L·cosθ（水平时最大）。: τ = m·g·L·cosθ, a maximum when the arm is horizontal.
map.水平臂重力平衡。: Balancing gravity on a horizontal arm.
map.平衡弹簧/配重设计。: Design of balancing springs and counterweights.
map.τ=m·g·L·cosθ=5×9.81×0.3×1=14.7 N·m（θ=0 水: τ = m·g·L·cosθ = 5 x 9.81 x 0.3 x 1 = 14.7 N·m, the maximum at θ = 0 when horizontal.
map.cos90=0 → 重力矩为 0，无需补偿。: cos 90° = 0, so the gravity torque vanishes and no compensation is needed.
map.臂与水平夹角；水平 θ=0 时重力矩最大。: The angle between the arm and the horizontal; the gravity torque peaks at θ = 0, the horizontal pose.
map.各连杆重力矩求和，质心法向距离累加。: Sum the gravity torque of each link, adding up the normal distance of each centre of mass.
